Deep-space explorer for the Shattered Planet run.
Successor to Lucid Explorer I, built by Forlda Deepforest.
Designed for stable travel into the densest asteroid fields.

Shattered Planet: 4,000,000 km (2026-09-13)

https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/forlda-deepforest/factorio-bp-images@main/screenshot_602378610_1308x1852.png

深部探査船 Lucid X II-03 Aft Stretch
Forlda Deepforestによって建造された Lucid Explorer I の後継機。
砕け散った惑星の最深部へ安定して航行できる性能を目指し、
高密度アステロイド群への対応力を極限まで研ぎ澄ませた傑作機。

A commemorative snapshot of the 4,000,000 km run (2026-09-13), saved as a record rather than a general-purpose design.
